verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly document a sanctioned rail for designees, authorized professionals or representatives to act for a company, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt HTTP 403 probes, which say nothing about any delegated-access mechanism, so there is no evidence the service delivers this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
